versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Whale Pulse Monitor for real-time BTC Orderbook Imbalance tracking.
- Detects high-conviction whale activity on OKX/Binance using Sovereign-Futures logic.
- Features include whale fingerprinting, S-Level Alerts (OBI > 5.0), and low-latency Rust backend.
- Runs via npx openclaw; access costs $0.25 USDC per use.
